headlines.title: Stephen Miller named as new White House chief of staff
headlines.description: President Trump has named his controversial deputy Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff, following the departure of Susie Wiles after Republican midterm losses. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Three found dead at home of gunman who killed six in Krakow, Polish PM says
headlines.description: Three people believed to be relatives of the gunman who killed six people in Krakow’s Main Market Square on Saturday were found dead at his home, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said.

headlines.title: An election night of firsts, and a soccer legend steps off the international stage: The news quiz
headlines.description: Bob Dylan meets the pope, a Republican plan backfires, and the Met Gala unveils its 2027 theme (again).

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Man arrested outside LeBron James’ L.A. home claiming to be his son
headlines.description: A man found outside LeBron James’ Los Angeles home has been arrested on suspicion of felony stalking, police say.

headlines.title: Trump offers press secretary position to UFC head Dana White
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said that he’d offered the job of White House press secretary to the CEO and president of the Ultimate Fighting Championship, Dana White.

headlines.title: 1 dead, at least 12 injured after elderly driver plows into group of cyclists in North Carolina
headlines.description: One cyclist was killed and at least 12 others were injured after an elderly driver, suspected to be impaired, plowed into a group of cyclists in North Carolina.

headlines.title: School aide who briefly served as NYPD officer arrested in fatal stabbing of Brooklyn jogger
headlines.description: A public school employee who briefly served as an NYPD officer has been charged with second-degree murder in the fatal stabbing of a 28-year-old female jogger in Brooklyn last week, an apparently random attack.

headlines.title: South Carolina man arrested after leaving sleeping 6-year-old daughter in line for Pokémon card release, police say
headlines.description: A man was arrested in Charleston, South Carolina, on Friday after leaving his 6-year-old daughter asleep outside a Target to hold his place in line for the release of a new Pokémon trading card set, police said.
